Locate the bowls.
<python>
if 'start' in globals():
    start('B', 'scripted check')
r = locate('bowl')
print(r['text'])
o = r['objects'][0]
arm = 'left' if o['position'][0] < 0 else 'right'
print(arm, o['id'], o['reach'])
</python>

Pick one and set it down 5 cm nearer the robot.
<python>
p = pick(arm, o['id'])
print(p)
if p['ok']:
    print(release(arm, x=o['position'][0], y=o['position'][1] - 0.05))
</python>

Push it back.
<python>
r = locate('bowl')
o = min(r['objects'], key=lambda item: abs(item['position'][0] - o['position'][0]))
print(push(arm, o['id'], o['position'][0], o['position'][1] + 0.04))
print(home())
</python>
